description: This file defines the PreferLocalPlacement class, a placement strategy for Orleans grains that prefers local host placement when possible. It contains the class implementation, including a singleton instance, and relevant documentation comments.

classes.name: PreferLocalPlacement
classes.description: A placement strategy indicating that a grain should preferentially be placed on the local host if compatible and not already active.

methods.name: Singleton
methods.description: A singleton property providing a single shared instance of PreferLocalPlacement.
